GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091 (1 Nov 45) GS
(SCAPIN - 222)
APO 500
1 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Abolition of the Regional Governments General and Establishment of Regional Administrative Affairs Bureaus.
The proposal of the Imperial Japanese Government to abolish the Regional Governments General and establish Regional Administrative Affaires Bureaus, as set forth in its memorandum of 28 September 1945, C. L. O. No97, on the above subject, is approved.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
